hero.headline: Black & Grey, American Traditional, cover ups
hero.sub: Heart and Soul Tattoo is a shop on Main Street in East Greenville. The work they name is Black & Grey, American Traditional, cover ups, and re-works. The shop minimum is $100. The shop is cash only. The artists are Scott Wilgeroth, Sam Vanderberg, Kevin Walker, and Josh Hernandez.

offerings.heading: What the shop will actually tattoo

items.title: Black & Grey and American Traditional
items.text: Those two styles are the published lanes. You come to Heart and Soul for Black & Grey or American Traditional, done by the artists on the wall.

items.title: Cover ups and re-works
items.text: Cover ups and re-works are shop work, not a favor. An old tattoo can be the reason you sit, and the shop treats that as a named service.

items.title: Cash only, $100 minimum
items.text: The shop minimum is $100. Payment is cash only. Those rules are theirs. Bring cash, and do not expect a $40 walk-in butterfly to clear the floor.

story.heading: Main Street, four artists
paragraphs: Heart and Soul Tattoo puts the rules on the table. Black & Grey. American Traditional. Cover ups. Re-works. One hundred dollars to sit. Cash only. Scott Wilgeroth, Sam Vanderberg, Kevin Walker, and Josh Hernandez are the artists. East Greenville is the town. 205 Main Street is the door.

A tattoo shop that publishes a minimum and a cash rule is doing you a favor. You know how to arrive. You know what styles they will stand behind. You know the names of the people who will do the work. Hours from their site run noon to 5pm Monday and Sunday, noon to 7pm Tuesday through Saturday.

experience.heading: How a sit at the shop actually works

items.title: Pick a published style
items.text: Black & Grey, American Traditional, a cover up, or a re-work. Those are the lanes. You talk the idea inside what the shop already does.

items.title: Sit with a named artist
items.text: Scott Wilgeroth, Sam Vanderberg, Kevin Walker, or Josh Hernandez. The tattoo is done by one of those four, in the East Greenville shop.

items.title: Clear the shop minimum in cash
items.text: The floor is $100. The till is cash only. You come ready for both, or you do not sit.

feature.heading: Styles, artists, rules
feature.text: Black & Grey and American Traditional are the styles. Cover ups and re-works are the repair work. Four named artists. Cash only. $100 minimum. Heart and Soul Tattoo is that list, on Main Street.

spotlight.heading: The artists are the shop
spotlight.text: Scott Wilgeroth, Sam Vanderberg, Kevin Walker, and Josh Hernandez are not decorations on a landing page. They are who tattoos at 205 Main Street. You sit with one of them.
